pending: This record has an approval pending: wait for the decision, or cancel the request.
decidedOtherwise: You already decided differently on this stage.
notAssignee: You are not an approver of this request's current stage.
selfApproval: You can't decide on your own request.
noApprovers: Nobody can approve this: stage "{stage}" found no approver.
notRequester: Only the requester can do this.
notChangesRequested: Only a request sent back for changes can be resubmitted.
unknownUser: No active user has this id.
delegationTooLong: A delegation lasts {days} days at most.
payloadFromRecord: This action's proposed change is read from the record: don't send one.
notStuck: Only an approved request whose outcome wasn't applied can be abandoned.
notManager: Only someone who may manage approvals can do this.
